summary: SKK Holdings Ltd files Form 6-K reporting entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire substantially all drone-based technology assets of Rantizo, Inc. for ~$759k cash plus ~$258.8 million in newly issued Class A ordinary shares (priced at VWAP over three days pre-closing). An independent third-party valuation by Newbridge Securities Corp. was obtained. Boards of both companies unanimously approved. Post-closing, Rantizo gets two board seats and an additional $10M private placement escrow converted into SKK shares. Regulatory clearance and shareholder approval required. Watch for Nasdaq listing compliance and closing timeline risk-arb.
